# YVR Garage Door Springs

> Emergency garage door spring repair across Greater Vancouver. Local technicians living in each of the 16 cities we serve — typically 12 minutes from your home. One service, three flat-rate tiers, no diagnostic fee, no after-hours surcharge. Quoted price = paid price. We also run a contractor partner network for overflow and out-of-scope work. Last updated: 2026-06-08.

## What we do

We replace broken residential garage door springs (torsion and extension). One service, done right, same day in most cases. We don't sell new doors, openers, or panels — just springs and the cables that work with them.

## Service area

We serve 16 Greater Vancouver cities, with a local technician living in each one. Average drive time from call to your door: ~12 minutes (12–18 depending on city):

Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, New Westminster, Delta, Langley, White Rock, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Tsawwassen.

## Pricing (flat-rate, all-in, plus GST/PST)

- **One Spring.** Rare. Other spring stays old. Cables not replaced.
- **Two Springs (95% pick this).** 5-year parts. 2-year labour. Cables included free. 10,000-cycle springs.
- **Two High-Cycle Springs.** 25,000-cycle springs (2.5× standard lifespan). Sealed bearings. 7-year parts. 2-year labour.
- Exact all-in tier prices are quoted by phone or text before we dispatch — same price 7 a.m. to 9 p.m., no diagnostic fee.
- **Wayne Dalton TorqueMaster like-for-like replacement.** Same proprietary sealed-tube system going back in.
- **Wayne Dalton TorqueMaster → standard torsion conversion.** Costs less today; future service uses standard off-the-shelf parts instead of proprietary special-order ones. 9 out of 10 BC homeowners pick the conversion. Exact all-in price quoted before we dispatch.

Same price 7 a.m. or 9 p.m. Tuesday or Saturday. No after-hours rate. No diagnostic fee. No surcharges on-site.

### Conversion hub
- [Home](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/): single-page conversion hub with pricing, diagnosis quiz, FAQ, and city links.
- [About](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/about/): the company model (local techs, one service), Dale McRae (East/Burnaby/North/Surrey/Coquitlam) and Madison Lim (Richmond/Delta/Tsawwassen/Steveston/White Rock) bios.
- [Contact](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/contact/): phone, email, SMS, hours, dispatch HQ, service area tiles.
- [Service Areas index](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/cities/): all 16 Greater Vancouver cities we cover, each with neighbourhood coverage and the resident tech.
- [Terms of Service & Warranty](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/terms/): pricing, payment, cancellation, parts/labour warranty (5-year / 2-year), scope of liability ($5M general + WorkSafeBC), BC dispute resolution.
- [Privacy Policy](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/privacy/): PIPEDA + BC PIPA compliant. What we collect, what we don't, opt-out paths. Google Ads active since May 2026 — discloses _gcl_au / _gcl_aw / gclid conversion-tracking cookies and opt-out links.
- [Become a Partner](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/partners/): contractor partner network. We refer overflow and out-of-scope work — full door installs, openers, loading docks, commercial doors, and skilled trades (hydraulics, electrical, welding, fabrication) — to vetted partners across Greater Vancouver. Partners quote, do, and bill the work directly; we make the introduction. Application form on the page; apply free, no exclusivity.

### Blog
- [Blog index](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/): all posts.
- [Heard a loud bang? Yeah, that was your spring.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/heard-a-loud-bang/): emergency-keyword response and what to do in the next 10 minutes.
- [Torsion vs. extension springs — which one is on your door?](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/torsion-vs-extension/): visual ID guide.
- [How long do garage door springs really last in Vancouver?](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/how-long-springs-last/): lifespan math, 5–10 yrs standard, 12–18 yrs high-cycle.
- [Wayne Dalton TorqueMaster — yes, we fix these.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/wayne-dalton-torquemaster/): conversion guide for TorqueMaster and TorqueMaster Plus sealed-tube systems.
- [Why cold snaps break springs — even mild Vancouver ones.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/cold-weather-springs/): ductile-to-brittle metallurgy, call-volume doubles after 0°C dips.
- [Why coastal garage door springs fail early.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/coastal-spring-corrosion/): salt-air corrosion in Tsawwassen / Richmond / White Rock / Steveston; oil-tempered + stainless cable spec. Madison Lim byline.
- [Opener won't lift the door — is it the opener or the spring?](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/opener-or-spring/): 30-second at-home diagnostic to distinguish opener failure from spring failure. Includes HowTo schema.
- [4 DIY maintenance tasks that won't kill you. And 3 that might.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/diy-garage-door-maintenance/): safe-vs-unsafe DIY guidance with explicit DANGER blocks on spring winding, cable replacement, and overhead positioning.
- [Three generations on Lulu Island.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/three-generations-lulu-island/): Madison's family-business history, 90 years of Richmond houses, why oil-tempered + stainless is the only honest spec on Lulu Island, partnership with Steveston Garage Doors.
- [Openers we'd buy. If we sold them.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/openers-we-recommend/): unbiased buyer's guide — LiftMaster Elite, Genie StealthDrive, Hörmann SupraMatic, Chamberlain. What to avoid. Refers customers to other contractors for the install.
- [Why we don't sell new garage doors.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/why-we-dont-sell-doors/): brand differentiator, business-model explainer, 3 questions to ask a contractor pushing a new door, list of trusted door-install referral partners.
- [The 60-second balance test: pull the red cord, lift to 3 feet, watch what happens.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/balance-test-60-seconds/): the single most useful DIY diagnostic; predicts the four failure outcomes (float, sag, slam, rise).
- [It's white lithium grease. It's not WD-40.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/lithium-grease-not-wd40/): why WD-40 strips the lubricants you need; correct lubricant + four lube points.
- [Photo-eye cleaning in fall fog season.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/photo-eye-cleaning-fall-fog/): why the door reverses on October mornings and how to fix it in 30 seconds.
- [Never replace your own torsion spring.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/never-replace-your-own-torsion-spring/): the safety case against DIY torsion-spring replacement; 250 lbs of stored energy.
- [Massey Tunnel and the politics of getting to Delta.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/massey-tunnel-bridge-politics/): why we have a Delta tech instead of dispatching across the tunnel.
- [Olympic-builder-grade doors are at end-of-life.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/olympic-builder-grade-doors/): the 2008–2010 builder-grade Clopay/Garaga wave is now 15+ years old and dropping in waves.
- [Cascadia earthquake — what happens to your garage door.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/cascadia-earthquake-garage/): seismic prep guide; emergency-release cord; manual override; battery-backup opener.
- [10 questions every strata council should ask before approving a garage door contract.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/strata-council-10-questions/): strata buyer's guide. Insurance, warranty, cycle ratings, lien questions.
- [Carriage doors to laneway homes — the Greater Vancouver door evolution.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/carriage-doors-to-laneway-homes/): 110 years of door styles in the Lower Mainland and how spring spec changes per era.
- [The atmospheric river and your cables.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/atmospheric-river-and-your-cables/): why frayed cables snap during November cable-corrosion season after the first pineapple-express.
- [Westwood Plateau's TorqueMaster crisis.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/westwood-plateau-torquemaster-coquitlam/): why a 1990s Coquitlam luxury showcase neighbourhood is hitting TorqueMaster end-of-life all at once.
- [Walnut Grove's third-generation TorqueMaster.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/walnut-grove-langley-torquemaster-1990s/): the 1990s Langley cul-de-sac TorqueMaster problem and conversion fix.
- [Why English Bluff TorqueMasters rust from the inside.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/tsawwassen-salt-air-torquemaster/): Tsawwassen salt-air corrosion inside sealed-tube TorqueMaster systems. Madison Lim byline.
- [Welcome to TorqueMaster country — Cloverdale and Clayton.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/cloverdale-clayton-surrey-torquemaster-country/): why Surrey's fast-growing Cloverdale/Clayton subdivisions are TorqueMaster-dense and what it means for owners.
- [Silver Valley and Albion — TorqueMaster Plus hits year ten.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/silver-valley-albion-maple-ridge-torquemaster-plus/): the Maple Ridge TorqueMaster Plus generation reaching end-of-life.
